scope: 11e6f18 (v0.1.32) to 3c578a5: a snapshot report asked one night (az_suppressed) is looked up by report, collected the next night and asked again in the same run; an ask older than 3 nights is asked afresh; the same ask still building keeps its own night; Amazon report and document ids pass a strict pattern before any request path. About 65 program lines (AS1 ~25; AS4 ~40 in pieces each under the 20-line threshold).

found.finding: One run a day: ask, collect, ask -> the snapshot landed every second night.
found.fix: After collecting an earlier night's ask, tonight's is asked in the same run.

found.finding: Re-remembering under today reset the ask's age, so a stuck ask was never asked again.
found.fix: The same ask keeps its own night; older than SNAPSHOT_ASK_KEPT_DAYS (3) it is asked afresh.

found.finding: A stale ask asked afresh that landed at once set off a second ask.
found.fix: The second ask only when an old ask was really handed to the door; check added.

found.finding: The second ask's outcome was not logged.
found.fix: A working or warning line; 2 checks.

found.finding: 4 changes no check noticed and 15 that crashed the checks files with no recorded reason (bare run and door calls in the checks).
found.fix: Every run and door call in the checks wrapped so a throwing one turns a check red; 6 checks added; the two real import crashes (runner.py `from reports import`, amazon_door.py `import re`) recorded under cannot_load after a reviewer tried them on a scratch copy.

found.finding: A cancelled or failed old ask is not asked again the same night; read_status does not compare the returned reportType; `import re` sits in its own group.
found.why: One night without the picture at worst; no wrong data; style only.
